verses.text: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.

footnotes.text: head: Olive oil was poured on Aaron's head to show that God had chosen him to be the high priest.

verses.text: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the LORD has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
